training.sampling: Equal crop probability; within crop 0.30 earlier20, 0.50 expanded synthetic, 0.20 realistic. Matched random examples across arms.

selection: Mean normalized MSE across available crop x management-family cells at 128 frozen validation sites and 18 allowed scenarios. Report per-crop and per-scenario metrics each epoch. No test or held-out scenario checkpoint selection.
interpretation: Iterated diagnostic benchmark: test sites and reserved scenarios excluded from new fits, but frozen-model test failures were previously inspected. Joint intervention tests coverage/sampling and crop branches/history; not a pure architecture ablation.
initialization: All new model weights random; no pretrained checkpoint loaded.

experiments.expanded_annual: Existing shared annual LSTM, expanded management and balanced crop/group sampling.
experiments.expanded_crop_history: Shared input embeddings, separate crop LSTM/attention/readout branches; wheat receives previous 365 real days plus current year; corn and soy receive current year.

test: 975 fixed excluded sites x 198 scenarios, 2001-2023. Distinguish 176 training schedules from 22 excluded schedules. Harvest records only; no yield autoregression.
selection_site_rule: Same 128 sampled ranks in the sorted validation pool as the reference experiment
